negative_findings.reason: Reviewed `prli_stripe_service_account_name` and related Stripe credential options. Store legs `process_update_creds()` and `process_refresh_tokens()` require a nonce plus `PrliUtils::is_authorized()` (`plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliStripeConnectController.php:99`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliStripeConnectController.php:114`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliStripeConnectController.php:168`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliStripeConnectController.php:178`); in the visible codebase `is_authorized()` resolves to `current_user_can(get_minimum_role())` with a default of `manage_options` (`plugins/pretty-link/app/models/PrliUtils.php:1016`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/models/PrliUtils.php:1031`). The stored account name is sanitized with `sanitize_text_field()` before `update_option()` (`plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliStripeConnectController.php:157`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliStripeConnectController.php:210`). The load leg in `plugins/pretty-link/app/views/admin/payments/options.php:70` only uses the value in HTML text context; a potential stored-XSS hypothesis was refuted because attacker-controlled markup is stripped on write.

Reviewed `prli_stripe_customer_portal`. The store path runs through the options form, which verifies the `update-options` nonce before saving (`plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliOptionsController.php:39`) and is only exposed from the options admin page. `configure_customer_portal()` sanitizes the user-controlled fields before sending them to Stripe (`plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliStripeController.php:1019`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliStripeController.php:1020`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliStripeController.php:1021`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliStripeController.php:1023`) and stores the returned configuration at `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliStripeController.php:1108`. Matching reads either stay in control flow / redirect decisions (`plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliStripeController.php:940`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliStripeController.php:990`) or are escaped at output (`plugins/pretty-link/app/views/admin/payments/options.php:162`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/views/admin/payments/options.php:190`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/views/admin/payments/options.php:204`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/views/admin/payments/options.php:218`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/views/prettypay/invoice.php:61`). Refutation attempt: no load leg was found where the stored structure reaches raw HTML output or SQL construction.

Reviewed `prli_authenticator_account_email`, `prli_authenticator_secret_token`, and `prli_authenticator_site_uuid`. The store leg in `process_connect()` only executes when `prli-connect=true`, a valid nonce is present, and `PrliUtils::is_authorized()` passes (`plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliAuthenticatorController.php:78`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliAuthenticatorController.php:83`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliAuthenticatorController.php:88`). The option values are sanitized before storage (`plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliAuthenticatorController.php:92`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliAuthenticatorController.php:93`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliAuthenticatorController.php:109`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliAuthenticatorController.php:113`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliAuthenticatorController.php:121`). Later reads feed JWT generation, remote requests, and connection-URL branching (`plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliAuthenticatorController.php:174`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliAuthenticatorController.php:175`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliAuthenticatorController.php:218`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/views/admin/payments/options.php:12`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliLinksController.php:1272`). Refutation attempt: no matching HTML or SQL sink was found for these stored values.

Reviewed `pl_review_prompt_removed`, `pl_review_prompt_delay`, `pl_dismiss_upgrade_header`, `prli_customer_portal_notice_dismissed`, and the dynamic `prli_dismiss_notice_*` keys. Store legs are nonce-gated and authorization-gated in `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliReviewNoticeController.php:15`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliReviewNoticeController.php:19`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliAppController.php:69`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliAppController.php:73`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliAppController.php:132`, and `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliStripeController.php:1140`. Matching reads are only boolean/timestamp checks controlling notice visibility (`plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliReviewNoticeController.php:54`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliReviewNoticeController.php:60`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliAppController.php:86`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliStripeController.php:979`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliStripeConnectController.php:289`). Refutation attempt: dynamic-key review did not produce a dangerous load sink, so there is no defensible stored XSS or second-order SQLi conclusion.

Reviewed popup state storage including `prli-popup-last-viewed`, dynamic stop keys, and related user meta. The AJAX store leg verifies a nonce, requires authorization, sanitizes the popup name, and rejects unknown popup names (`plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliPopupController.php:90`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliPopupController.php:94`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliPopupController.php:102`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliPopupController.php:104`). Matching reads in `is_popup_stopped()` and `get_popup_last_viewed_timestamp()` (`plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliPopupController.php:165`, `plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliPopupController.php:179`) are only used for flag/timestamp comparisons in `popup_visible()` (`plugins/pretty-link/app/controllers/PrliPopupController.php:190`). Refutation attempt: the dynamic storage keys are constrained to known popup identifiers and never reach output or SQL sinks.
